_doc: fc/wp = volumetric field capacity / wilting point (m3/m3), typical FAO-56 / USDA texture-class values. infil = approximate basic infiltration (mm/h). lime_per_ph = tonnes CaCO3/ha to raise pH by one unit. ratings follow the Indian Soil Health Card limits (available N, Olsen P, ammonium-acetate K in kg/ha; organic carbon %).

sandy.name: Sandy
sandy.notes: Drains fast, low nutrient holding. Irrigate light and often; add organic matter.

loamy.name: Loamy
loamy.notes: Balanced drainage and fertility. Suits most crops.

clay.name: Clay
clay.notes: Holds water and nutrients, drains slowly. Avoid waterlogging; irrigate less often but deeper.

silty.name: Silty
silty.notes: Fertile and moisture-retentive; prone to crusting and compaction.

black.name: Black (Regur)
black.notes: High water holding, cracks when dry. Good for cotton, soybean, pulses.

red.name: Red
red.notes: Well drained, often low in N, P and organic matter.

alluvial.name: Alluvial
alluvial.notes: Fertile river-deposited soil; good for cereals, sugarcane and vegetables.
